name: pi-lean-dimension
description: Read-only REST API client for Pi. Your agent authors and calls YAML recipes handling the tedious parts: pagination, OAuth2, rate limits, backoff. Credentials live in a local store, injected in code, never in agent context. Churn-free research + retrieval
